name: @a2app/reverse-proxy
description: Sidecar A2App adapter for foreign apps adopted as-is: starts the app from a declarative sidecar.json, serves the A2App surface on the app's port, and forwards declared operations to the app's own routes; operate-only, entities:{} by design

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node test/proxy.test.mjs && node test/sidecar.test.mjs
